tests.scope: CPU contracts, profiling payload identity / baseline selection / all-row failure gates, provenance, existing CUDA helpers, and vc23 production max-state / row-bias helpers on SM86. No full Hopper attention execution.
tests.helper_result: Packed P and all tested maximum/alpha/mass/denominator/output values match baseline with zero tolerance. Independent PyTorch max, FP8 decode and recurrence checks also pass.
tests.cases: 1/2/7/296 tiles; random/stable/rising maxima; fallback; lane-specific scales; sparse updates; nondefault stream; stable maximum with varying gain; tiny max updates whose exponential rounds to one; transitions into/out of affine-safe range.

sm90a_cross_compile.control_flow: Two main-loop exponent instructions conditional on max-update vote. Maxstate uses predication; cached-bias candidate branches around exponent and two row-bias FMA instructions. No timing inference.
sm90a_cross_compile.scope: SASS instruction text comparison excludes encodings/control words. Unchanged original QK/PV group ordering in main and masked tail.

h200_validation: Not run locally. Remote validation adds 240 dtype/shape/algorithm/mode cases repeated 3 times, 16 uniform-attention known answers and 24 fixed-payload max-update cases before timing.
h200_performance: Not measured. Must beat same-run vc22_both full API; predication/branch costs, persistent bias registers and update frequency can offset savings. No new speedup or 22 ms claim.
default_kernel: vc15 unchanged; vc22_both retained as measured experimental baseline
